modeHint.standard: Fill in the name, descriptions and governance labels; warehouse rules are validated live and the DDL is generated for you
modeHint.ddl: Paste a CREATE TABLE statement; the structure is parsed and moved into Standard mode to complete governance metadata

basic.title: Name & description
basic.desc: The table name follows the warehouse convention: layer_domain_subject_period

labels.title: Governance labels
labels.desc: Asset tier, security tier, owner and business description drive governance and access approval

columns.title: Columns
columns.desc: Describe every column and tag its security tier; the table tier is set automatically to the highest column tier

placeholders.subject: e.g. order, user_profile
placeholders.comment: One sentence on content and grain, e.g. Order detail, one row per order
placeholders.businessDescription: Business background, main use cases, data sources and metric definitions (at least 20 characters)

hints.subject: Lowercase letters, digits, underscores; up to 32 characters

naming.rule: Rule: {layer}_{domain}_{subject}_{period}. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only; 64 characters max.
naming.invalid: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only, starting with a letter

P0.name: Temporary
P0.desc: Personal or temporary use, no downstream dependencies

P1.name: General
P1.desc: Used within a team, few downstream dependencies

P2.name: Important
P2.desc: Used across teams, feeds important reports or metrics

P3.name: Core
P3.desc: Core business asset; changes need strict review and it must have an owner and quality monitoring

L0.name: Public
L0.desc: Safe to share company-wide, no sensitive information

L2.name: Confidential
L2.desc: Sensitive business data or personal information; access needs approval

L3.name: Restricted
L3.desc: Highly sensitive data (e.g. ID numbers, account details); tightly restricted access

levelHint.auto: Set automatically to the highest column tier — no manual selection needed
levelHint.pending: Appears once columns are tagged with a security tier

checks.title: Governance checks
checks.allPassed: All checks passed — ready to submit

items.name: Table name follows the convention
items.columnSecurity: Every column has a security tier

preview.title: DDL preview
preview.desc: Generated live from the form, including governance and column security tags

submit.failed: {{count}} checks still failing — complete them first
submit.sandbox: Sandbox: submitting only creates a request; the DDL is not executed

success.title: Table request submitted
success.desc: {{name}} passed every governance check and was submitted as {{id}}. The DDL was not executed in the sandbox.

ddl.title: Paste CREATE TABLE SQL
ddl.desc: Supports Delta / Hive style CREATE TABLE: column types, NOT NULL, COMMENT, PRIMARY KEY, PARTITIONED BY and table COMMENT

errors.empty: Enter a CREATE TABLE statement first
errors.unbalanced: Parentheses in the column list do not match — check the SQL

warnings.nameIncomplete: Original name {{raw}} does not follow the convention — complete layer / domain / subject / period below
warnings.noTableComment: The SQL has no table COMMENT — add a table description
warnings.missingColumnComments: {{count}} columns have no COMMENT — add descriptions

parsed.title: Parsed {{count}} columns from the DDL
parsed.body: The structure is imported. Next, complete the asset tier, security tier, business domain, owner and business description.

list.searchPlaceholder: Search request ID, table, description or requester
list.emptyHint: Adjust the filters or create a new request

create.title: New table request
create.breadcrumb: TRUST / Data Governance / Table Management / New

detail.notFoundBody: Request {{id}} does not exist or has been cleared.
